# PitchPulse data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `matchmind-sim dictionary`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from the event model (`backend/src/matchmind/schema/events.py`, exported as
`backend/schema/event.schema.json`) and measured on the bundled dataset
(`backend/data/matches`). To refresh it after a schema or data change, run
`cd backend && matchmind-sim dictionary`; a test fails while it is out of date.

Everything described here is **synthetic**: produced by the PitchPulse match engine
with invented clubs and players. See `docs/DATASET.md` for how it is made and its
realism limits.

Schema version: `1.0`.

## Frames, clocks and ids

- **Pitch**: metres on a 105 x 68 pitch. `x` runs along the length
  from the home goal line (0) to the away goal line (105); `y` runs across (0-68),
  `y = 0` being the touchline on the home club's right as it attacks. The **home club
  attacks towards x = 105 for the whole match** and the away club towards x = 0; ends
  do not switch at half time. Every position in an event is in this absolute frame.
- **Clock**: `clock_s` is the match clock in seconds. Period 1 starts at 0 and its
  stoppage time runs past 2700; period 2 restarts at 2700 and its stoppage runs past
  5400. So `clock_s` alone is not monotonic across half time: order by `seq`, or by
  `(period, clock_s)`. Several events can share the same second.
- **Broadcast clock**: `match_clock` is `MM:SS`, or `45+M:SS` / `90+M:SS` in stoppage.
- **Wall clock**: `ts` is UTC: kick-off time plus real elapsed time, including a
  15-minute half-time break.
- **Ids**: `match_id` (`MM-DEMO-001` scripted demo, `MM-SYN-nnn` bundled unscripted,
  `MM-GEN-nnnnn` seeded on request); `event_id` = `<match_id>-<seq, 5 digits>`;
  team ids are 2-4 capital letters; `player_id` = `<team>-<shirt number>`.
- **Speeds**: metres per second (`ball_speed_mps`, `player_speed_mps`).
- **Labels** are ground truth for evaluation only; consumers strip them before
  anything reaches a model.

## Event fields (one JSON object per line)

| field | type | constraints | presence | unit / frame / id rule | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | "1.0" |  | default `"1.0"` | contract version; bumped on a breaking change | Event contract version. |
| `event_id` | string |  | required | id: `<match_id>-<seq, 5 digits>` | Unique id of the event. |
| `match_id` | string |  | required | id, e.g. `MM-DEMO-001`, `MM-SYN-003`, `MM-GEN-01000` | The match this event belongs to. |
| `seq` | integer | >= 0 | required | order key; the only reliable order across the half-time clock reset | Strictly increasing order within a match. |
| `ts` | string (ISO 8601 date-time) |  | required | UTC; kick-off + real elapsed time (15 min half-time break included) | Wall-clock time the event happened (UTC). |
| `period` | integer | >= 1, <= 2 | required | 1 or 2 | Half: 1 or 2. |
| `clock_s` | number | >= 0 | required | seconds; period 1 runs from 0 (stoppage past 2700), period 2 restarts at 2700 | Match clock in seconds; period 2 starts at 2700. |
| `match_clock` | string |  | required | text, `MM:SS` or `45+M:SS` / `90+M:SS` | Broadcast clock, e.g. '67:20' or '90+2:15'. |
| `type` | enum `EventType` |  | required |  | What happened (enum EventType). |
| `team` | string or null |  | default `null` | team id (`NBR`, `HCY`) | Team of the actor; empty for match-level events. |
| `player_id` | string or null |  | default `null` | player id `<team>-<shirt number>` | The actor. |
| `receiver_id` | string or null |  | default `null` | player id | Intended receiver of a pass (set even if incomplete). |
| `possession_id` | integer or null |  | default `null` | counter, new value when the team on the ball changes | Possession the event belongs to. |
| `start` | `Point` or null |  | default `null` | metres, absolute frame | Where the action started. |
| `end` | `Point` or null |  | default `null` | metres, absolute frame | Where the ball (or carrier) ended up. |
| `outcome` | enum `Outcome` or null |  | default `null` |  | How the action ended (enum Outcome). |
| `ball_speed_mps` | number or null |  | default `null` | metres per second | Ball speed of a pass, shot or clearance. |
| `player_speed_mps` | number or null |  | default `null` | metres per second | Actor's speed (carries, dribbles, runs). |
| `under_pressure` | boolean |  | default `false` |  | An opponent was close enough to press the actor. |
| `pressure_players` | array of string |  | optional | player ids | The pressing opponents. |
| `body_part` | enum `BodyPart` or null |  | default `null` |  | Shots: the body part used. |
| `freeze_frame` | array of `FramePlayer` or null |  | default `null` | metres, absolute frame | Shots only: everyone in or around the box (final 35 m) at the moment of the shot. |
| `tracking` | array of `TrackingFrame` or null |  | default `null` | every 0.5 s, metres, absolute frame | Runs only: runner, ball carrier, back line and keeper every 0.5 s for 3 s. |
| `lineups` | array of `LineupPlayer` or null |  | default `null` | both squads | match_start only. |
| `details` | object of string or integer or number or boolean |  | optional | see 'Details by event type' | Type-specific extras. |
| `labels` | array of string |  | optional | `prefix:value`; strip before anything reaches a model | Ground-truth labels for evaluation (scripted beats, pressure spells). Consumers must strip these before anything reaches an agent. |

## Nested types

### `FramePlayer`

One player's location inside a shot freeze frame or a tracking frame.

| field | type | constraints | presence | unit / frame / id rule | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player_id` | string |  | required | player id | The player. |
| `team` | string |  | required | team id | The player's team. |
| `x` | number | >= 0, <= 105 | required | metres, absolute frame | Position along the length. |
| `y` | number | >= 0, <= 68 | required | metres, absolute frame | Position across the width. |
| `teammate` | boolean |  | required |  | True if on the same team as the event's actor. |
| `keeper` | boolean |  | default `false` |  | The player is a goalkeeper. |
| `actor` | boolean |  | default `false` |  | The player is the event's actor. |

### `LineupPlayer`

| field | type | constraints | presence | unit / frame / id rule | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player_id` | string |  | required | player id `<team>-<shirt number>` | The player. |
| `team` | string |  | required | team id | The player's club. |
| `name` | string |  | required |  | Invented player name. |
| `number` | integer |  | required | shirt number | Shirt number. |
| `position` | string |  | required | position code (GK, RB, RCB, CDM, CAM, ST, ...) | Starting position. |

### `Point`

| field | type | constraints | presence | unit / frame / id rule | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | >= 0, <= 105 | required | metres, 0 = home goal line, 105 = away goal line | Along the pitch length. |
| `y` | number | >= 0, <= 68 | required | metres, 0-68 across the pitch | Across the pitch width. |

### `TrackingFrame`

Positions at one instant inside a run window (every 0.5 s).

| field | type | constraints | presence | unit / frame / id rule | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t_offset_s` | number | >= 0 | required | seconds after the run event's clock_s | Time of this frame after the event. |
| `ball` | `Point` |  | required |  | Ball position. |
| `players` | array of `FramePlayer` |  | required |  | Player positions. |

## Enums

### `BodyPart`

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `right_foot` | Right foot. |
| `left_foot` | Left foot. |
| `head` | Header. |

### `EventType`

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `match_start` | First event: clubs in `details.home` / `details.away`, line-ups, seed. |
| `period_start` | Kick-off of a half. |
| `pass` | A pass; `details.pass_type` is ground, cross, through_ball or kickoff. |
| `carry` | The player runs with the ball. |
| `dribble` | A take-on; `details.opponent_id` is the defender beaten (or not). |
| `shot` | A shot, with a freeze frame; goals carry the new score in details. |
| `run` | An off-ball run in behind, with 3 s of tracking; found or not found. |
| `interception` | A pass cut out. |
| `tackle` | A tackle that wins the ball. |
| `clearance` | A defensive clearance. |
| `recovery` | A loose ball picked up. |
| `foul` | A foul; `details.fouled_id` is the player fouled. |
| `card` | A booking; `details.card` is yellow or red. |
| `milestone` | A scripted personal milestone (`details.label`). |
| `period_end` | End of a half, with the score. |
| `match_end` | Last event, with the final score. |

### `Outcome`

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `complete` | Pass reached a teammate. |
| `incomplete` | Pass did not reach a teammate. |
| `out` | Ball went out of play. |
| `won` | Duel or take-on won. |
| `goal` | Shot scored. |
| `saved` | Shot saved by the keeper. |
| `blocked` | Shot blocked by an outfield player (`details.blocked_by`). |
| `off_target` | Shot missed the target. |
| `found` | Run was picked out by a pass. |
| `not_found` | Run was not picked out. |

## Details by event type

`details` is a flat object of strings, integers, numbers and booleans. Keys ending in
`_id` are player ids. Measured on the bundled matches:

| event type | details keys seen |
|---|---|
| `match_start` | `away`, `home`, `seed` |
| `pass` | `pass_type` |
| `dribble` | `opponent_id` |
| `shot` | `assist_id`, `blocked_by`, `score_away`, `score_home` |
| `run` | `carrier_id` |
| `foul` | `fouled_id` |
| `card` | `card` |
| `milestone` | `label` |
| `period_end` | `score_away`, `score_home` |
| `match_end` | `score_away`, `score_home` |

Label prefixes seen (events carrying each):

- `better_option`: 2
- `pressure_spell`: 333
- `scripted`: 36

## Export files

`GET /api/dataset/export` and `matchmind-sim export` (docs/DATASET.md) write these.
CSV conventions: UTF-8, LF line endings, `true`/`false`, ISO-8601 UTC, empty for null
(the Lakehouse export's rules).

### `events.csv` (flat view; nested arrays are in `events.jsonl`)

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `event_id` | string | Unique id: &lt;match_id>-&lt;seq, 5 digits>. |
| `match_id` | string | Match id (see match.json). |
| `seq` | int64 | Order within the match, from 0, strictly increasing. |
| `ts` | timestamp | Wall-clock time the event happened (UTC). |
| `period` | int64 | 1 or 2. |
| `clock_s` | float64 | Match clock in seconds; period 2 starts at 2700. |
| `match_clock` | string | Broadcast clock, e.g. 67:20 or 90+2:15. |
| `type` | string | Event type (enum EventType). |
| `team` | string | Team id of the actor, or empty. |
| `player_id` | string | Actor, &lt;team>-&lt;shirt number>, or empty. |
| `receiver_id` | string | Intended receiver of a pass (set even if incomplete). |
| `possession_id` | int64 | Possession counter; changes when the team on the ball changes. |
| `start_x` | float64 | Start x in metres, 0-105; home attacks towards 105. |
| `start_y` | float64 | Start y in metres, 0-68. |
| `end_x` | float64 | End x in metres, 0-105. |
| `end_y` | float64 | End y in metres, 0-68. |
| `outcome` | string | Outcome (enum Outcome), or empty. |
| `ball_speed_mps` | float64 | Ball speed in metres per second. |
| `player_speed_mps` | float64 | Actor's speed in metres per second. |
| `under_pressure` | bool | An opponent was close enough to press the actor. |
| `pressure_players` | string | Pressing opponents' player ids, separated by ';'. |
| `body_part` | string | Shots: right_foot, left_foot or head. |
| `freeze_frame_players` | int64 | Shots: players in the freeze frame (frame itself in the JSONL). |
| `tracking_frames` | int64 | Runs: tracking frames attached (frames themselves in the JSONL). |
| `details` | string | Type-specific extras as one JSON object (see the dictionary). |
| `labels` | string | Ground-truth labels separated by ';' (evaluation only). |

### `rosters.csv`

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `team_id` | string | Club id. |
| `team_name` | string | Club name (invented). |
| `side` | string | home or away in this match. |
| `player_id` | string | &lt;team>-&lt;shirt number>. |
| `number` | int64 | Shirt number. |
| `name` | string | Player name (invented). |
| `position` | string | Position code, e.g. GK, RCB, CAM, ST. |
| `line` | string | GK, DEF, MID or FWD. |

### `tracking.csv` (optional; 25 Hz, one window of at most 60 s)

Synthetic tracking rendered from the events by the auto-eventing renderer
(`autoevent/tracking.py`): 2D positions, measurement noise and ball drop-outs
added. One row per object per frame (the ball, then every player). It is not video.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `period` | int64 | 1 or 2. |
| `clock_s` | float64 | Match clock in seconds at this frame (25 frames a second). |
| `ball_alive` | bool | Ball in play at this frame. |
| `object` | string | 'ball' or a player id. |
| `team` | string | Player's team, empty for the ball. |
| `x` | float64 | x in metres, 0-105; empty while not tracked (ball hidden, player sent off). |
| `y` | float64 | y in metres, 0-68; empty while not tracked. |

## Scenarios and seeds

Same scenario + same seed = byte-identical events.

| scenario | meaning |
|---|---|
| `demo_storyline` | Scripted demo storyline: home club 2-0 up, red card 52', pressure 60-75', away win 3-2 in stoppage time, two missed square balls and an unfound run. |
| `chance_model` | Unscripted: every goal comes from the engine's own chance model. |
| `chance_model_with_beats` | Chance model plus 3 decision beats ('should he have passed?' shots and unfound runs), marked scripted:* in the labels. |

| match | scenario | seed | home | away | score | events |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---:|
| `MM-DEMO-001` | `demo_storyline` | 100 | NBR | HCY | 2-3 | 2069 |
| `MM-SYN-001` | `chance_model` | 101 | NBR | HCY | 3-1 | 2162 |
| `MM-SYN-002` | `chance_model` | 102 | HCY | NBR | 0-1 | 2109 |
| `MM-SYN-003` | `chance_model` | 103 | NBR | HCY | 1-0 | 2087 |
| `MM-SYN-004` | `chance_model` | 104 | HCY | NBR | 1-2 | 2006 |

Seeded matches: `MM-GEN-<seed>` for seeds 1000-1019 through
the API, any seed 0-99999 through `matchmind-sim export --seed`; scenario
`chance_model_with_beats`, home and away alternate with the seed.
